entries.note: NDA 210259 bundle: quote verbatim. Mouse PD first public 2015 at earliest, after ibrutinib (2013) and acalabrutinib (Byrd 2015) patient occupancy, so retro, not same. Oral acalabrutinib, R/R CLL: fields right.

entries.rule: Retrodiction (engagement: any drug of same target and action)
entries.note: Tam 2019 abstract (epub 2019-07-24): quote verbatim. Guo 2019 model side epub 2019-08-19, after ibrutinib/acalabrutinib and Tam's own occupancy, so retro. Oral zanubrutinib; mixed B-cell phase 1 coded unselected is fine.
NDA 210259 bundle: quote verbatim. Mouse PD gave mg/kg ED50s only; 100 mg BID set on ACE-CL-001 patient occupancy. Untested holds; drug=acalabrutinib, route=oral right.

entries.note: Herman 2017 full text: corrected quote now verbatim incl. 'compared to vehicle treatment'. Mouse data post-date ibrutinib and acalabrutinib CLL responses: retro. drug=acalabrutinib, route=oral right.

Ghia 2020 abstract quote verbatim. AstraZeneca release of 7 May 2019 confirms ASCEND met IRC-PFS primary, so year 2019. Canine data (2014) after ibrutinib CLL responses (2013): retro. Monotherapy, oral acalabrutinib, R/R: fields right.
Byrd 2016 full text: both sentences verbatim. Ex-vivo platelet data and first acalabrutinib patient safety public together, so not a retrodiction; same holds. drug=acalabrutinib, route=oral right.
Byrd 2021 abstract/PMC8547923: conclusion verbatim. ELEVATE-RR all del(17p)/del(11q), biomarker_selected right; prospective head-to-head, same holds. drug=acalabrutinib, route=oral right.

BeiGene release 28 Apr 2021 (CancerNetwork) reports significantly lower AF/flutter vs ibrutinib in ALPINE interim, so year 2021. Brown 2023 quote verbatim. Head-to-head result unknown before, so same not retro. Oral zanubrutinib right.

entries.rule: Safety: passing tolerability claim scored; retrodiction that failed is contra
entries.note: NDA 210259 bundle: n=612 bleeding sentence verbatim across a page break; dog tox 'Toxicities were limited to...' verbatim, dog platelet aggregation unremarkable. Own CLL data public 2015: retro that failed, contra. Oral acalabrutinib right.
Demin 2025 (PMC12001278, epub 2025-02-12): quote verbatim in abstract. Zanubrutinib track opener at model first use, untested no_prediction. drug=zanubrutinib, route=oral right.
Demin 2025 abstract and full text: quote verbatim; QSP fitted/validated on known clinical occupancy, so retro. Oral zanubrutinib 160 mg BID: drug and route right.
NDA 210259 bundle: PBPK sentence verbatim. Sponsor Simcyp model opener 2017, untested. drug=acalabrutinib, route=oral right; healthy-volunteer DDI coded unselected.

QSP target-occupancy model for zanubrutinib/acalabrutinib compared with patient occupancy and PFS (CPT Pharmacometrics Syst Pharmacol, https://doi.org/10.1002/psp4.13307); likely a retrodiction, in_silico track.
rule_questions: Rat/dog GLP tox: dogs reported unremarkable platelet aggregation and no bleeding at exposures above clinical, yet ~50% of patients had bleeding events and AF 3%. Is that a silence a dog 'could have shown' (contra) or unsettled because ibrutinib-class harms were already expected?

Can one selectivity-panel track (and one mouse-PD track) span two member drugs whose panels were run by different sponsors (Acerta vs BeiGene), or does each sponsor's assay count as a separate model system?

Must each track open with a model_first_use_year untested entry (rule 6) when its first comparison came later? The mouse-PD (2015) and selectivity tracks open directly with same; lint does not flag it.
